subject: GreenLeaf Health — DPA routing, SCC module selection & security questionnaire kickoff
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@greenleafhealth.com>, James Porter <james.porter@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, KarThik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GreenLeaf Health — DPA routing, SCC module selection & security questionnaire kickoff

Hi Samantha / James,

Thanks again for your time this morning — great discussion and helpful context on your EU/US footprint. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of asks from your side:
- Confirmation of data roles: you indicated GreenLeaf will be the Controller for patient/customer data; Redwood will act as Processor for hosted inference.
- Formal DPA to be agreed and signed (you requested SCC-based module selection).
- SOC 2 Type II report and data retention details for legal/procurement review.
- Vendor security questionnaire (procurement wants this completed) and PO template to support procurement timelines.

Attachments: GreenLeaf-DataFlow-Diagram.png (image/png) — your annotated flow from today; Vendor-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet) — procurement template you shared.

Proposed next steps (suggested owners):
1) I'll loop in Legal to propose a default Processor-focused SCC module and a standard Redwood DPA (ACTION: KarThik — please confirm if we should propose Module Two or the processor variant of the new modular SCC today).
2) Ben will share our most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a short data-retention FAQ for your legal team.
3) Procurement to send PO template and we’ll confirm timeline — aiming for a 10-business-day review window if possible.
4) Initiate vendor security questionnaire: Ben, can you own the questionnaire kickoff and set a shared Drive folder?

If that plan looks good, Samantha — can you confirm on a couple quick points so our legal team can prepare the proper SCC module: 
- Is GreenLeaf formally taking Controller status for the data types discussed? (I recall yes, but want explicit confirmation)
- Do you require BAA/HIPAA coverage for the vendor (you mentioned some US operations)?

Aim: get DPA + SCC preference and SOC2 by Friday 6/18 so Procurement can move to PO.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

Subject: Re: GreenLeaf Health — DPA routing, SCC module selection & security questionnaire kickoff

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the clear next steps. Confirmations from our side: 

- GreenLeaf Health will be Controller for customer/patient data.
- We do require HIPAA coverage for the subset of US operations that use the product. If Redwood provides a BAA, that will accelerate procurement.
- For the SCCs: our legal prefers the Processor-oriented modular clauses (we use the Modular SCCs that map to Processor responsibilities). We do ask vendors to indicate which module they present as baseline.

Procurement notes: we attached our PO template (GreenLeaf-PO-Template.pdf) and will share a filled version once legal finishes review. For the vendor questionnaire — please send responses to procurement@greenleafhealth.com and cc me. We’d like the questionnaire completed by 6/18 to stay on track.

Thanks,
Samantha
Director of Partnerships
GreenLeaf Health

Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: RE: GreenLeaf Health — DPA routing, SCC module selection & security questionnaire kickoff

Folks — quick internal note before we respond to GreenLeaf: 

1) SOC 2: I’ve uploaded the most recent SOC 2 Type II (2026) to our secure docs and will attach a redacted copy to the questionnaire responses. Link (internal): https://app.redwood/documents/SOC2-Redwood-2026-TypeII.pdf
2) SCC / DPA approach: KarThik — recommend we propose the Processor modular path (module that maps to controller = GreenLeaf, processor = Redwood). I suggest we include an optional BAA addendum for the HIPAA scope rather than an unconditional BAA; legal can redline.
3) Questionnaire: I’ll own completing the Vendor-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx and will drop answers + artifacts into the Drive folder. Action: Ben to send completed questionnaire to procurement@greenleafhealth.com by 2027-06-14.
4) Pricing/credits: Laura — please confirm that we can offer 30 days of onboarding credits if legal requests time-bound escrow or additional logging for EU customers.

Action items assigned: 
- Ben: SOC2 packet + questionnaire (due 6/14).
- KarThik: prepare DPA + SCC Processor-module draft and BAA addendum option (legal review by 6/17).
- Marissa: coordinate with GreenLeaf on timeline and confirm PO expectations.
- Mina: prepare a short data-retention/PII handling FAQ for EU data (to include in questionnaire).

I’ll prepare a short email to procurement to attach SOC2 and the completed questionnaire when ready.

Ben Carter
Security Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Ben / Marissa — appreciate the quick internal alignment. A few clarifications from procurement/legal: 

- We expect a redacted SOC 2 by 6/14 — please include the auditor's name and the scope (infosec + availability controls).
- For HIPAA: our legal will review the BAA addendum; if Redwood can confirm willingness to sign a BAA, that will be a strong positive indicator.
- Questionnaire: we’ll accept the completed Vendor-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx and any supporting artifacts in a shared Drive link. Please send to procurement@greenleafhealth.com.

Also, please provide a single point-of-contact for exec-level escalation and a timeline for the DPA signature (our target: complete legal review by 6/25).

Thanks — we’ll route to legal and get back if they have redlines.

James Porter
Senior Procurement Manager | GreenLeaf Health
